222-527-955-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

2043-4050-5446-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}
Repeat.
2043-4050-5446-7824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

1115-1563-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1594-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2946-3220-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-3220-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-5477-5660-6968-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-2921-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-3817-5686.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

141-1269-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-6798.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

427-1247-5963.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
427-1247-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kydele's ability by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

465-3817-3967.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

390-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph
390-5299-5466.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Hulking Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Hulking Metamorph's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

152-2499-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-2499-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1987-3277-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3277-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Pinnacle Monk
When Izzet Chronarch and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

539-1115-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-1115-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

3388-5745-5746.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3388-5745-5746.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Marit Lage's Slumber's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Marit Lage Slumber trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2366-4862-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Omnath's first ability triggers, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elemental dies, Omnath's second ability triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2092-2429-3193.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-2429-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1636-2609-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least four untapped creatures, one of which must be white.
1636-2609-4113.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by tapping four creatures you control, one of which must be white.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
